preconditions.expression: root is None or isinstance(root, TreeNode)
preconditions.description: The input root must be either None or a valid TreeNode instance representing the root of a BST.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(node, TreeNode) for node in [root] + [node.left for node in [root] if root] + [node.right for node in [root] if root]) if root else True
preconditions.description: Every node in the BST must be a valid TreeNode instance with left and right attributes (which may be None).

preconditions.expression: all(node.left.val < node.val < node.right.val if node.left and node.right else True for node in [root] + [node.left for node in [root] if root] + [node.right for node in [root] if root]) if root else True
preconditions.description: The BST property must hold: for every node, all values in its left subtree are less than its value, and all values in its right subtree are greater than its value.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(node, TreeNode) for node in [return_value] + [node.left for node in [return_value] if return_value] + [node.right for node in [return_value] if return_value]) if return_value else True
postconditions.description: The returned root must be either None or a valid TreeNode instance, and all nodes in the modified BST must be valid TreeNode instances.

postconditions.expression: all(node.left.val < node.val < node.right.val if node.left and node.right else True for node in [return_value] + [node.left for node in [return_value] if return_value] + [node.right for node in [return_value] if return_value]) if return_value else True
postconditions.description: The BST structure must be preserved in the modified tree: for every node, all values in its left subtree remain less than its value, and all values in its right subtree remain greater than its value.

postconditions.expression: all(node.val == original_val + sum(original_val > val for val in [original_val] + [n.val for n in [root] if root] + [n.left.val for n in [root] if root and root.left] + [n.right.val for n in [root] if root and root.right] if n.val != original_val else [])) for node in [return_value] + [node.left for node in [return_value] if return_value] + [node.right for node in [return_value] if return_value] if return_value else True)
postconditions.description: For every node in the modified BST, its value must equal the sum of its original value and all values in the original BST that are greater than its original value. The original BST is the input BST before modification.

postconditions.expression: all(node.val == node.left.val + node.right.val + node.val - original_val if node.left and node.right else node.val == node.left.val + node.val - original_val if node.left else node.val == node.right.val + node.val - original_val if node.right else True for node in [return_value] + [node.left for node in [return_value] if return_value] + [node.right for node in [return_value] if return_value] if return_value else True)
postconditions.description: The modified BST must satisfy the property that each node's value is the sum of its original value and all greater values in the original BST, computed recursively via reverse inorder traversal (right-root-left).
